title: 1BR Rosemary Beach Rental with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Highland Carriage House, a 1BR, 1BA Rosemary Beach rental, with a sofa bed, private beach access, steps from the Racquet and Sky pool. Sleeps 4.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhether as additional accommodations to the on-site Highland Cottage or a luxury getaway all by itself, the Highland Carriage House provides an elegant simplicity that will both charm and delight you.Located just steps from the Racquet Club, tennis courts and Sky pool, the Highland Carriage House is in the middle of exclusive Rosemary Beach. Originally conceived as a planned community, you’ll notice that every home here has an inviting wrap-around porch, perfect for sipping coffee in the morning and sweet tea in the afternoon.Exceedingly pedestrian-friendly, wind your way through the secret pathways between the homes and carriage houses for a romantic stroll. Spend a day on the sugar sand beach and the evening wandering through the New Orleans-inspired Town Center.The town of Rosemary Beach also features 4 separate pools strategically located within the community, available for all residents and guests.Known as a foodie destination, you’ll enjoy the variety of delicious restaurants, from romantic special occasion spots to casual beachside joints and everything in between.Back at your carriage house, you’ll ascend a flight of steps and enter your cozy nest through a covered portico. A separate covered deck off the living room offers a scenic view of the community.The spacious living room offers a lovely conversation area with a comfortable convertible sofa and two side chairs. Enjoy your favorite show or a great movie on the HDTV.The living space is awash in natural light, casting a warm and inviting glow over the whole area. A dining table for four is tucked in the corner, overlooking the outdoors.The kitchen, while not large, offers everything needed to prepare a full meal, including an under-the-counter refrigerator, a full-size stove and dishwasher, and a microwave.The cozy bedroom has a queen-size bed and another HDTV. The fun retro-style bath, with its checkerboard tiles, is ensuite.Carriage House: Living room with sleep sofa, two side chairs, coffee table, end tables, HDTVDining area with table for fourKitchen with under-the-counter refrigerator, stove, dishwasher, microwave, coffee maker, and toasterBedroom with queen-size bed, dresser, dual nightstands, and HDTVEnsuite bathComplete Clean Bedding Program**Can also be rented with the Cottage; see our listing for The Highland Cottage.
